title: Scrub video
description: A video clip you move with the scroll: on a web page it stays pinned while the scroll winds the film forward and back; on a slide it plays once. A time code and a thin gold line follow the picture. Give the face box and the words stay beside the person.

props.src: required, mp4 or webm (a key frame every second or closer scrubs smoothly)
props.title: heading beside the picture
props.seconds: how much of the clip to use (default: the first 6 s)
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture
props.side: left (default) or right: where the words go
props.poster: still shown before the video loads

example.title: Your scroll is the play head
example.text: On a slide the same clip simply plays.
